title: 1hrPVTdataset_allSubjects
description: This dataset contains scalp EEG recordings from healthy adult participants collected during a one-hour session involving either 40 Hz audiovisual flicker stimulation, no flicker (control), or randomized flicker (sham) conditions. Throughout the recording session, participants performed a psychomotor vigilance task (PVT), enabling investigation of the effects of rhythmic sensory stimulation on vigilance and neural activity.
methods_description: Scalp EEG activity was recorded from healthy adults during one hour of either 40 Hz audiovisual flicker, no flicker control, or randomized flicker sham stimulation, while subjects performed a psychomotor vigilance task.
